slots.notes: Center-node brand logomark (the 'Xero X'), viewBox 0 0 40 40, rendered 28x28 fill:white inside the 64x64 neumorphic hub; the focal point of the icon pipeline.
Top-left navbar wordmark, currently the text 'Xero' (700 weight); swap for brand wordmark text or small inline logo.

Two decorative Lucide-style line glyphs flanking the hub (left: 'layers' stacked diamonds, right: 'shield-check'); 20x20, stroke rgba(255,255,255,0.7), 1.5 width, no fill, round caps. Swappable to brand-thematic line icons.

Monochrome social-proof logo strip (placeholder set: Expedia, asana, zenefits, HubSpot, loom); each a 22x22 inline SVG + wordmark, tinted rgba(255,255,255,0.35). Replace with real customer/partner logos.
Single typeface driving the whole page; Inter (weights 300,400,500,600,700,800) via Google Fonts. Display heading leans on the light 300/400 weights and tight -0.02em tracking.

mechanic: A requestAnimationFrame state machine (p1 -> splash -> p2 -> idle, ~3.4s loop) slides a bright window along a userSpaceOnUse gradient beam node-to-node across a neumorphic icon pipeline, lighting each side node and firing a scaling radial splash at the central hub, all framed by a stops-tuned radial pink-magenta arc and a masked crosshatch grid.
techDelivery: single-page React + TypeScript (Vite) with plain global CSS (no Tailwind in the hero), Inter via Google Fonts, all iconography as hand-authored inline SVG, animation driven by useRef + a single useEffect requestAnimationFrame loop with a resize listener.
reskinNotes: Heavy baked-in branding: the signature arc is ~15 hand-tuned rgba/hex stops in a ::before radial-gradient, the beam linearGradient and all node/brand-row icons carry hex/rgba inline in SVG markup, every string (nav links, headline 'The simple way / encryption your data', subhead, CTA, 5 brand names) is hardcoded in JSX, and the light-weight (300/400) heading with -0.02em tracking plus the gradient text-clip is metric-dependent on Inter — substituting a font will shift the arc/heading alignment and the beam path is recomputed from live getBoundingClientRect geometry.
